title: CDH Profile
description: CDH policy schema: the core composed with all CDH-maintained extensions, requiring the cdh extension on every Hub record. Applied as the policy layer (validate-yaml --profile) on top of the per-record mechanism check (core + declared extensions only), and bound by editors via the yaml-language-server modeline for autocomplete. A single-file bundled copy is published alongside as cdh.schema.bundled.json.

allOf.description: JSON Schema for validating CDH metadata input YAML records before serialization to STAC or OGC API Records. This validates structure, types, controlled values, and basic input rules; CDH review still handles contextual and curatorial checks.

^\\$schema$.description: Canonical JSON Schema URL for validating this metadata record.

access.description: Access condition for the resource's data, distinct from license. Omitting it means public. Aligned to the DCAT / EU accessRights vocabulary: public (openly accessible); restricted (discoverable, but obtaining the data requires a request or authentication); non-public (catalogued but not available through public channels).

access_note.description: Human-readable access conditions or instructions. Required when access is restricted or non-public; maps to schema.org conditionsOfAccess.

additional_assets.description: Sidecar or auxiliary assets, e.g. metadata files or thumbnails.

file_size.description: File size in bytes (integer) or a human-readable string (e.g. 1.2 GB).

locations.description: Access paths to the same content; the first is canonical.

title.description: Optional access label, e.g. HTTPS or S3.

media_type.description: Media type (IANA), optionally with format parameters such as profile or version.

name.description: Asset name; becomes the asset key in serialized output, so it must be unique across data[] and additional_assets[].

roles.description: Asset roles, e.g. metadata, thumbnail, or describedby.

additional_links.description: Related links: citation targets, services, or related resources.

rel.description: Link relation type, e.g. cite-as or describedby.

cdh_schema_version.description: CDH standard version this record targets. Matches the release tag: v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>.

title.description: Cite-as title; may differ from the record's top-level title.

date.description: Publication date or year, e.g. 2024 or 2024-07-15.

publisher.description: Publisher or venue: the data publisher/repository for datasets, or the journal for articles.

roles.description: Roles this contact holds (one or more).

created.description: Date or date-time. Use YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-23) or an RFC 3339 date-time (e.g. 2026-06-23T00:00:00Z).

data.description: Data assets for the resource; at least one entry.

file_size.description: File size in bytes (integer) or a human-readable string (e.g. 1.2 GB).

locations.description: Access paths to the same content; the first is canonical.

title.description: Optional access label, e.g. HTTPS or S3.

media_type.description: Media type (IANA), optionally with format parameters such as profile or version.

name.description: Asset name; becomes the asset key in serialized output, so it must be unique across data[] and additional_assets[].

href_template.description: Optional relative file-name pattern appended to each locations[].url. Each {token} must match a dimensions[].name or be the reserved {variable} token, which expands over variables[].name (requires the datacube extension); the entry expands to one item per combination of the tokens' values. When absent, locations[].url are full file URLs and the entry is a single asset.

nodata.description: No-data / fill value for the asset.

processing_steps.description: ids of processing[] steps that produced this asset.

deprecated.description: true when a newer release supersedes this record. Set on version snapshots.

description.description: Canonical human- and AI-readable summary of the resource.

extensions.description: Pinned URLs of the CDH extension schemas this record uses.

id.description: Short, stable, URL-safe identifier (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

keywords.description: Free-text search terms. Each item is either a plain string, or an object linking the term to an external vocabulary/ontology (e.g., AGROVOC, GEMET). Linked-keyword items are also emitted as ontology themes in the serialized output, grouped by `scheme`.

scheme.description: Resolvable URI of the controlled vocabulary or ontology this term comes from.

uri.description: Resolvable URI of the specific concept within `scheme`.

license.description: License of the data as an SPDX license expression. Custom LicenseRef-* expressions must be accompanied by an additional_links[] entry with rel: license.

note.description: Caveats, warnings, or interpretation-critical remarks not captured in description.

previous_version.description: id of the predecessor record, when this supersedes an earlier version.

processing.description: Ordered processing/provenance steps; at least one must have id: source.

code.description: Software or code that produced this step's output. Omit when none is published.

url.description: Link to the production code or repository.

version.description: Version, tag, or commit of the code.

date.description: Date or date-time. Use YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-23) or an RFC 3339 date-time (e.g. 2026-06-23T00:00:00Z).

derived_from.description: Upstream sources this step derived from - the data (e.g. a Zenodo/Dataverse landing page), not code.

id.description: Step identifier; one step must use id: source for the original generation.

related_publications.description: Related works such as papers or reports.

title.description: Cite-as title; may differ from the record's top-level title.

date.description: Publication date or year, e.g. 2024 or 2024-07-15.

publisher.description: Publisher or venue: the data publisher/repository for datasets, or the journal for articles.

resource_type.description: Kind of resource the record describes (vocab/resource_type.json).
resource_type.title: CDH Resource Type Vocabulary

series.description: Dataset series / product family the resource belongs to (e.g., MapSPAM, GLW). `name` is the series label; `url` is the series landing page.

bbox.description: Spatial extent. A single bounding box, or a list of boxes for disjoint coverage - each box is a real area covered, in any order; the overall/union extent is derived when serializing, not authored. 2D = [west, south, east, north] = [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]; 3D = [west, south, min_z, east, north, max_z]. WGS84 (EPSG:4326); elevation in metres.

oneOf.description: A single bounding box: 2D [west, south, east, north], or 3D [west, south, min_z, east, north, max_z]. WGS84 (EPSG:4326); elevation in metres.

items.description: A single bounding box: 2D [west, south, east, north], or 3D [west, south, min_z, east, north, max_z]. WGS84 (EPSG:4326); elevation in metres.

crs.description: Coordinate reference system of the data: EPSG code, CRS URI, or PROJ string.

geography.description: Named places for discovery (vocab/geography.json ids, UN M49).

items.title: CDH Geography Vocabulary
items.description: Generated from vocab/geography.json. Do not edit this file directly; update the JSON vocabulary and regenerate schemas.

geometry_column.description: Name of the geometry column, for vector tables.

label.description: Human-readable resolution, e.g. 5 arc-minutes or Kenya counties.

reference_system.description: For point/polygon types, the system defining the reporting units (e.g. GAUL 2015, GADM).

type.description: Resolution type: xy (regular grid), x, y, point, or polygon.

unit.description: Unit of measurement, preferably compliant with UDUNITS-2 or UCUM. Non-grid spatial units may use clear labels such as admin-level.

value.description: Numeric resolution value (grid spacing, or admin level).

temporal.description: Coverage extent, precision-aware. Use `date` for a single instant or period (date: 2020 = the year 2020), or `start_date` + `end_date` for a span (end_date: null = open-ended). `date` and `start_date`/`end_date` are mutually exclusive. Temporal cadence is not recorded here - declare a type: temporal dimension (datacube extension) instead.

date.description: A single instant or period; its precision sets the granularity (year, month, day, or datetime).

end_date.description: End of a span; null for an open-ended series.

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 date/time; the precision states the granularity - year (2020), month (2020-06), day (2020-06-23), or an instant (2020-06-23T00:00:00Z). As an end, it is inclusive through the end of that period (end: 2010 means through 2010-12-31).

updated.description: Date or date-time. Use YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-23) or an RFC 3339 date-time (e.g. 2026-06-23T00:00:00Z).

version.description: Version of the resource, when versioned.

allOf.title: Climate Data Hub Metadata Input Schema
CDH Extension
allOf.description: CGIAR Climate Data Hub governance fields.

domain.description: CDH domain(s); closed vocabulary (vocab/domain.json). Drives catalog browse and filtering.

items.title: CDH Domain Vocabulary
items.description: Generated from vocab/domain.json. Do not edit this file directly; update the JSON vocabulary and regenerate schemas.

not_recommended_for.description: Uses to avoid, each with a reason and optional alternative.

allOf.title: Climate Extension
allOf.description: Climate projection provenance: baseline, bias adjustment, downscaling, scenarios.

baseline.description: Reference/baseline period the projections are expressed against.

start_date.description: Date or date-time. Use YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-23) or an RFC 3339 date-time (e.g. 2026-06-23T00:00:00Z).

end_date.description: Date or date-time. Use YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-23) or an RFC 3339 date-time (e.g. 2026-06-23T00:00:00Z).

bias_adjustment.description: Bias adjustment applied to the projections.

reference_dataset.description: Reference dataset used for bias adjustment.

mip_era.description: CMIP era of the source models.

models.description: Climate model source IDs; use 'ensemble' for a multi-model ensemble.

scenarios.description: Scenario labels, e.g. SSP/RCP or historic.

allOf.title: Datacube Extension
allOf.description: Dimensions and variables for gridded, multidimensional, or tabular data.

dimensions.description: Cube axes: domain axes (e.g. crop, scenario), bands, and temporal axes (each type: temporal with a step). Not the lat/lon grid - that comes from the top-level spatial field; the top-level temporal field holds only the coverage extent.

name.description: Axis name. Must not be "variable": measures are not axes and belong in variables[]; href_template refers to them via the reserved {variable} token.

description.description: What the dimension is; define coded values here, or via reference_system or a sidecar.

type.description: Dimension type: a domain axis (e.g. crop, scenario), bands, or temporal. Declare every temporal axis here with a step; the top-level temporal field holds only the coverage extent. The lat/lon grid comes from the spatial field, not here.

reference_system.description: Vocabulary the dimension's values are coded against; prefer a resolvable URI when one exists (e.g. an AGROVOC concept scheme).

step.description: Spacing of one step, as an ISO 8601 duration. Only valid on a type: temporal dimension.

description.description: Stable definition and reading guidance for the variable.

dimensions.description: Axes this variable spans; omit when it spans all declared dimensions.

unit.description: Unit of measurement, preferably compliant with UDUNITS-2 or UCUM.

joins.description: Joins from this table to other catalogued datasets. Each entry pairs this record's key columns with the target's columns, positionally.

target.description: Resolvable URI or id of the dataset joined to (e.g. a boundary/station record).

left_fields.description: Key columns in this record; each must be a declared dimensions[]/variables[] name.

right_fields.description: Matching columns in the target, paired positionally with left_fields (same length).

allOf.title: Classification Extension
allOf.description: Class definitions for categorical / classified variables.

classes.description: Class definitions for categorical variables; each entry maps to a variable.

variable.description: Name of the variable these classes apply to.

values.description: The class values for the variable.

value.description: The coded value as stored in the data.

allOf.title: Agriculture Extension
allOf.description: Agricultural commodities described by the record.

commodities.description: Agricultural commodities described by the record; CDH vocabulary (vocab/commodity.json).

items.title: CDH Commodity Vocabulary
items.description: Generated from vocab/commodity.json. Do not edit this file directly; update the JSON vocabulary and regenerate schemas.

^\\$schema$.description: CDH profile schema URL for any released version; its version segment must match cdh_schema_version (checked by validate-yaml).
